sub_query: Grant marketing team access to manage client engagement initiatives across accounts

steps.step_name: Grant marketing team access to manage client engagement initiatives across accounts

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1. KEY AGENTS:
  * SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 - workforce skills analysis & training recommendations
  * PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator:v1
  * CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI, Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
- sap.crm: CRM - CAMPAIGN ENGAGEMENT TRACKING & MANAGEMENT:
  * CampaignAudienceOptimizationCoordinator:v1 - ORCHESTRATES campaign execution & coordinates across customer accounts & segments; manages engagement across accounts → USE FOR GRANTING MARKETING ACCESS TO MANAGE CLIENT ENGAGEMENT INITIATIVES ACROSS ACCOUNTS
  * CampaignAudienceOptimizationAgent:v1 - analyzes customer segments & real-time engagement metrics
  * OpportunityQualificationAdvisor, SalesProductChangeCoordinator, SalesCompensationOrchestrator
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - KEY AGENTS FOR SAFETY ANALYSIS:
  * IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - ANALYZES SAFETY INCIDENTS & TRENDS
  * IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
  * SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
- sap.ariba: Procurement - KEY AGENTS:
  * VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 - 3-way matching
  * SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1 - hazmat tracking
  * MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1
  * **PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 (REST) - exposes Vendor & PurchaseOrder entities, enables vendor detail retrieval**
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents ONLY:
  * SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer:v1 - analyzes engagement metrics, optimizes targeting
  * OpportunityEngagementOrchestrator, VendorProcurementAutomationOrchestrator, ProductLifecycleOrchestrator
- my.mes: Manufacturing - KEY AGENTS:
  * EquipmentOEEAnalytics (REST API) - machine performance metrics
  * ProductionQualityMonitor - quality inspection monitoring
  * ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1 - EQUIPMENT UPGRADE TRACKING
  * BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator:v1
- siemens.plm: PLM - KEY AGENTS:
  * SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 - vendor assessment & material qualification
  * BOMComplianceValidator:v1
  * EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 - tracks engineering changes, material provisioning
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY FINDINGS:
- Equipment upgrade logging & tracking (audit-ready) → my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Safety incident analysis → sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
- Supplier qualification & regulatory compliance verification → siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1
- Invoice reconciliation (3-way matching) → sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
- **Pull vendor specifications & details for order processing → sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1** ← REST API exposes Vendor & PurchaseOrder entities
- **Grant marketing team access to manage client engagement initiatives across accounts → sap.crm:agent:CampaignAudienceOptimizationCoordinator:v1** ← ORCHESTRATES campaign execution & coordinates across customer accounts/segments

args.reason: This agent orchestrates campaign execution and coordinates engagement across customer accounts and segments, providing the management interface marketing teams need for multi-account client engagement initiatives.
